text:
Alicia M.: heads-up - cohort-mapper v2 rolled the new price sheet at 2026-11-08T09:00Z and ~34 accounts that had grandfather_tag=true were transitioned. Spreadsheet: https://docs.redwood/finance/cohort-mapper-11-08 (view).

Tom B.: which field did the mapper use for matching? cohort_id or billing_account_id?

Alicia M.: mapper used owner_email by mistake in the new transform. Should have used billing_account_id.

Ravi S.: CSV snippet from export: 
user_email,account_id,applied_sheet
ops@example.com,acc_900,new-rate-v3
ops+alt@example.com,acc_900,new-rate-v3

Tom B.: yep duplicates by email caused acc_900 to receive new-rate twice in downstream. Patch: change join to billing_account_id and add dedupe on account_id.

finance-bot: Automated audit: 34 accounts with unexpected price changes, 8 invoices generated between 2026-11-08 and 2026-11-09. Audit ref: https://ops.redwood/audit/FIN-5300.

Billing Ops: pause rollout approved. For invoices <30 days we'll issue credit memos; >30 days route to Legal. Prepare AM list for exposures >$1k.

Legal: note - invoice edits >45 days require CRO sign-off. For mass memos include opt-out info.

Alicia M.: actions: 1) PAUSE rollout, 2) run reverse-job and dry-run on 100 accounts, 3) patch mapper and re-run remap, 4) open FIN-5300 and post results. I'll schedule a 30m sync in 15m.

Tom B.: running dry-run query now: SELECT account_id, SUM(delta) FROM billing_deltas WHERE run='cohort-mapper-20261108' GROUP BY account_id LIMIT 100; posting checksum when done.

finance-bot: dry-run complete (100 sample): 12 mismatches found, checksum e3d7f1. Full reverse scheduled pending patch.

Alicia M.: thanks team. Please update FIN-5300 with run outputs and any customer flags.
